headline: De Cuyper leads, test3331 left counting
deck: testf beat test3331 46-19, De Cuyper's nine the top score of the tie
body:
testf carried this on defenders. De Cuyper's nine led it, with Rúben and Tarkowski both on six and a clean sheet's worth of coverage across the back. Add Tavernier's six in midfield and Rogers and Evanilson up top, and testf had six men returning and nobody dragging.

test3331's total tells the other story. Nineteen from six players, and Leno's seven from goal was the only stat line that stood up. Everything in front of him folded.

McBurnie's four was the best of the outfield returns, and that is the number test3331 will chew on. Barkley and Scott managed two apiece, Ajer and Lewis-Potter one each. Six starters, five of them in single figures, against a testf side that never dropped below five. Twenty-seven is a hole no single haul was ever going to fill.
